title: Nemo tushen dalilin, gudanar da aikin, bayar da shawarar a fili

say: Nemo tushen dalilin, gudanar da aikin da kyau, kuma bayar da shawarar a fili.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module na biyu na Muhimman Shawarwari.
Ba kwa buƙatar software mai tsada. Fayil ɗin rubutu, kayan aikin bincike, babban fayil ɗin da aka raba da ƴan kayan aikin tunani sun isa.

Ba kowane ginshiƙi taken aiki, kamar: dalilai uku suna haifar da 80% na koke-koke.

Bayanan hira, albashi da lissafin abokin ciniki sirri ne. Ajiye su a cikin manyan fayilolin da aka kare kalmar sirri, raba tare da mutanen da aka ambata a cikin yarjejeniyar, kuma kada ku sake amfani da bayanan abokin ciniki ga wani.
